productContext: Internal analytics product used by growth teams. Exploring a new 'experiment snapshot' feature.

evidence.content: Growth analyst: 'I spend 30 minutes rebuilding the same chart after each experiment ends.'
Ticket #4821: 'Can I export experiment results to a shareable link?'
52% of experiments never get a written read-out within 5 business days.
VP Growth: 'A snapshot should capture hypothesis, metrics, guardrails and a conclusion area.'
